prompt: write an example scope of work for waste management for a hospital
response: The scope of work for waste management in a hospital involves the collection, segregation, storage, and disposal of all types of waste generated. It includes managing general waste, recyclables, hazardous waste, and biomedical waste according to local regulations. The waste management team will ensure that all waste is handled safely and efficiently, minimizing environmental impact. They will also implement waste reduction strategies and provide training to staff on proper waste management procedures. Regular audits will be conducted to ensure compliance with waste management standards.
